nodes.label: Napoleon Documentation Contract
nodes.rationale: Non-test Python in this repo must use Napoleon sections and #: comments so documentation stays machine-checkable rather than ad hoc.

nodes.label: Testing Contract
nodes.rationale: django-sphinx-hosting is a reusable module and needs the sandbox/demo Django project plus containerized make test for integration coverage.

nodes.label: Private Sphinx Documentation Hosting
nodes.rationale: Internal Sphinx docs may be too sensitive to share with a third-party hosting service, so the app provides a private authenticated platform.

nodes.label: REST API
nodes.rationale: The REST API exists so CI/CD systems can programmatically import and manage documentation.

nodes.label: EXCLUDE_FROM_LATEST
nodes.rationale: Pre-release version globs are excluded so those versions are not marked latest and are not indexed in the search engine.

nodes.label: Strict Navigation Item Configuration
nodes.rationale: Invalid menu item schemas, unknown keys, or invalid builder return types raise request-time errors so configuration bugs stay visible and diagnosable.

nodes.label: TokenAuthentication
nodes.rationale: TokenAuthentication is only an example; hosts may choose any DRF DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES.

nodes.label: django-wildewidgets
nodes.rationale: All HTML in django-sphinx-hosting is generated by django-wildewidgets rather than conventional Django templates.

nodes.label: API Read vs Write Access
nodes.rationale: Authenticated users get read-only API access; write access requires the Django groups defined in the authorization overview.

nodes.label: Global Table of Contents
nodes.rationale: Sidebar navigation and Next/Previous/Parent buttons come from Sphinx toctree structure, not from filesystem layout or django-sphinx-hosting itself.

nodes.label: sphinxcontrib-jsonglobaltoc
nodes.rationale: Prefer jsonglobaltoc over next-key traversal so in-page section anchors appear in sidebar navigation and :caption: settings are obeyed.

nodes.label: JSON Page Tree Traversal
nodes.rationale: Without jsonglobaltoc, django-sphinx-hosting builds a global TOC by starting at the root page and following the next key in each .ftjson file.

nodes.label: Sphinx Heading Level Strategy
nodes.rationale: Root page titles must be level 1 and other page titles level 2; competing heading levels produce broken nesting in the global TOC because Sphinx infers structure from heading succession.

nodes.label: Viewers
nodes.rationale: Users in none of the privilege groups can search and read docs but cannot create, modify, or delete anything.

nodes.label: Sphinx JSON Tarball Package
nodes.rationale: Imported files must live under a top-level json/ folder inside the tar.gz so the importer can locate fjson, globalcontext, and static assets.

nodes.label: EXTRA_MENU_ITEMS
nodes.rationale: Use static EXTRA_MENU_ITEMS when a sidebar link should always be present without forking package views.

nodes.label: MENU_ITEM_BUILDERS
nodes.rationale: Use request-time builders when links depend on user or request state; exceptions propagate so configuration bugs are visible.

nodes.label: NAVBAR_CLASS
nodes.rationale: Replace the entire sidebar class via NAVBAR_CLASS while keeping package views unchanged.

nodes.label: sphinx_rtd_theme Required Theme
nodes.rationale: Importers, views, and stylesheets depend on the HTML structure, Javascript, and CSS classes of the Read the Docs theme.

nodes.label: sphinxcontrib-jsonglobaltoc
nodes.rationale: The optional globaltoc key in each .fjson file lets django-sphinx-hosting build navigation more reliably for complex page hierarchies.

nodes.label: PROJECT_DETAIL_LAYOUT_BUILDERS
nodes.rationale: Host projects can extend ProjectDetailView layout without subclassing package views; builders are append-only after built-in widgets.

nodes.label: Unified Search
nodes.rationale: One global search page blends SphinxPage hits with host models in a single Haystack-ranked list; the app adds no model-based boosts, tie-breakers, or grouping so ranking quality depends on comparable search-index design.

nodes.label: SEARCH_RESULT_RENDERERS
nodes.rationale: Host models participate only when they have both a Haystack SearchIndex and a renderer; renderer exceptions are not swallowed so configuration bugs fail the request.

nodes.label: Token Based Authentication
nodes.rationale: API callers must be Django users with an associated API Token and send Authorization: Token <hex> on each request. The literal prefix Token is required, separated by whitespace from the token value.

nodes.label: API List Pagination
nodes.rationale: All list results are paginated with a default page size of 100 because some queries are very costly, especially for models with many rows. Clients follow next/previous URLs or pass limit to change page size.

nodes.label: Project
nodes.rationale: machine_name is unique and read-only; it must be the slugified Sphinx conf.py project value.

nodes.label: Version
nodes.rationale: Users can get, list, and delete Version objects but cannot create or update them the normal Django way; new versions enter via tarball import. archived versions are excluded from search indexes.

nodes.label: SphinxPage
nodes.rationale: Pages are read-only in the API because they should be updated in the source Sphinx project, not the database. Derived fields have interdependencies that must be accounted for while editing. orig_* fields are retained so body and TOCs can be reprocessed later. body is stored as a Django template.

nodes.label: SphinxImage
nodes.rationale: Images are purposely read-only because they are dependent objects of SphinxPage instances and should not be updated independently.

nodes.label: VersionUpload
nodes.rationale: Import work is done in VersionUploadView. The tarball is uploaded to a temporary directory that disappears at the end of the view. Submit multipart form-data with a single file key named file.

nodes.label: Sphinx Lettermark S
nodes.rationale: A white serif capital S is the sole glyph, identifying the demo app with Sphinx documentation at favicon and homescreen sizes.

nodes.label: Circular Lettermark Logo
nodes.rationale: A single white serif S centered on a solid blue circle against a black square keeps the 192x192 Android Chrome icon readable as a geometric emblem at small sizes.

nodes.label: Android Chrome 512x512 App Icon
nodes.rationale: Square 512x512 PNG with a high-contrast white serif S on a solid blue disc, sized for Android/Chrome home-screen and PWA install icons so the demo site remains recognizable at small touch-icon scales.

nodes.label: PWA Android Chrome Touch Icon
nodes.rationale: The android-chrome-512x512.png filename is the conventional Web App Manifest high-resolution icon for Chrome on Android when a site is installed or pinned.

nodes.label: Sphinx Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: A lone serif S on a blue disc is consistent with Sphinx documentation branding for this django-sphinx-hosting demo, but the image itself does not spell out the word Sphinx.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon
nodes.rationale: Square iOS home-screen glyph for the sandbox demo site: a white serif capital S centered in a solid medium-blue circle on a black square canvas. The black padding lets iOS apply its rounded-rect mask without clipping the circular badge.

nodes.label: Sphinx S Monogram
nodes.rationale: The white uppercase serif S is the sole emblem; serif terminals echo traditional documentation and publishing typography associated with Sphinx.

nodes.label: Circular Badge Layout
nodes.rationale: A centered circular badge on a square canvas is a home-screen icon pattern that keeps the emblem intact after Apple’s rounded-rect clipping.

nodes.label: 16x16 Favicon
nodes.rationale: High-contrast white lettermark on a dark blue circular field so the mark stays legible at 16x16 browser-tab size; anti-aliased edges trade sharpness for smoothness at this pixel budget.

nodes.label: Favicon 32x32
nodes.rationale: Square 32x32 PNG used as the sandbox demo site's browser-tab and bookmark icon.

nodes.label: Serif S Monogram
nodes.rationale: White uppercase serif S centered on the blue disc; compact letter-mark for tab scale.

nodes.label: Sphinx Brand Initial
nodes.rationale: The letter S is read as a Sphinx initial given the django-sphinx-hosting demo context; the image itself does not spell out Sphinx.

nodes.label: Sphinx Hosting Brand
nodes.rationale: Pairs a recumbent sphinx (knowledge, documentation heritage) with a stacked serif wordmark on navy to present hosting as established and professional rather than purely technical.

nodes.label: Horizontal Icon-Wordmark Lockup
nodes.rationale: A bright medium-blue line-art sphinx is separated from stacked white serif 'Sphinx' / 'Hosting' by a thin vertical rule on a dark navy field, a standard brand lockup that splits symbol from name while keeping one horizontal unit.
